MT5._Provider_comment: Manager = MetaQuotes Manager API (native DLLs in Connector\Libs). LiveBridge = Live Bridge push feed (placeholder until published; configured in the LiveBridge section). Override per environment with env var MT5__Provider.

LiveBridge._comment: Only used when MT5:Provider = LiveBridge. Url stays empty until the Live Bridge feed is published. ApiKey must come from the environment (LiveBridge__ApiKey), never from this file.

Supabase._Key_comment: Set the Supabase API key via env var SUPABASE__KEY (not in this file). This file is tracked in git; secrets must never live here. The previous inline anon JWT (committed up to security/strip-supabase-jwt) was rotated and the old key was neutralized via Supabase RLS. Use service_role key in env var so backend can bypass RLS.
